note: Counts and ranks follow the De Laurence 1916 text. Where the classified list (p. 35) and the entry text (pp. 25–33) differ, this is flagged in 'variants'.

demons.name: Bael
demons.appearance: Divers shapes — sometimes like a Cat, sometimes like a Toad, and sometimes like a Man, and sometimes all these forms at once. Speaks hoarsely.
powers: Makes the practitioner go invisible

demons.name: Agares
demons.appearance: An old fair Man, riding upon a Crocodile, carrying a Goshawk upon his fist; mild in appearance.
powers: Makes them to run that stand still
Brings back runaways
Teaches all Languages or Tongues presently
Destroys Dignities both Spiritual and Temporal
Causes Earthquakes
demons.notes: Was of the Order of Virtues. Under the Power of the East.

demons.name: Vassago
demons.appearance: Not described in the text (of the same nature as Agares).
powers: Declares things Past and to Come
Discovers all things Hid or Lost

demons.name: Samigina
demons.appearance: A little Horse or Ass; then changes into Human shape at the request of the Master. Speaks with a hoarse voice.
powers: Teaches all Liberal Sciences
Gives account of Dead Souls that died in sin

demons.name: Marbas
demons.appearance: At first a Great Lion; afterwards, at the request of the Master, Human Shape.
powers: Answers truly of things Hidden or Secret
Causes Diseases and cures them
Gives great Wisdom and Knowledge in Mechanical Arts
Can change men into other shapes

demons.name: Valefor
demons.appearance: A Lion with an Ass's Head, bellowing.
powers: A good Familiar
Tempts them he is a familiar of to steal

demons.name: Amon
demons.appearance: Like a Wolf with a Serpent's tail, vomiting flames of fire from his mouth; at command puts on the shape of a Man with Dog's teeth in a head like a Raven, or a Man with a Raven's head.
powers: Tells all things Past and to Come
Procures feuds
Reconciles controversies between friends
demons.notes: 'Great in power, and most stern'.

demons.name: Barbatos
demons.appearance: Appears when the Sun is in Sagittary, with four noble Kings and their companies of great troops.
powers: Gives understanding of the singing of Birds and voices of other creatures
Breaks open Hidden Treasures laid by the Enchantments of Magicians
Knows all things Past and to Come
Conciliates Friends and those in Power
demons.notes: Was of the Order of Virtues, of which some part he retains still.

demons.name: Paimon
demons.appearance: A Man sitting upon a Dromedary with a Crown most glorious upon his head; an Host of Spirits goes before him like Men with Trumpets and well-sounding Cymbals and other musical instruments. Great Voice; roareth at first coming.
powers: Teaches all Arts and Sciences and other secret things
Discovers what the Earth is and what holds it up in the Waters
Discovers what Mind is and where it is
Gives Dignity and confirms the same
Binds or makes any man subject unto the practitioner
Gives good Familiars
demons.notes: Very obedient unto LUCIFER. Of the Order of Dominations. Two Kings called LABAL and ABALIM attend him, with other Spirits of the Order of Potentates and 25 Legions. To be observed towards the West.

demons.name: Buer
demons.appearance: Appears in Sagittary; that is his shape when the Sun is there.
powers: Teaches Philosophy, both Moral and Natural, and the Logic Art
Teaches the Virtues of all Herbs and Plants
Heals all distempers in man
Gives good Familiars

demons.name: Gusion
demons.appearance: Like a Xenopilus.
powers: Tells all things Past, Present, and to Come
Shows the meaning and resolution of all questions
Conciliates and reconciles friendships
Gives Honour and Dignity unto any
demons.notes: 'Great and strong Duke'.

demons.name: Sitri
demons.appearance: At first with a Leopard's head and the Wings of a Gryphon; after the command of the Master of the Exorcism, Human shape, and that very beautiful.
powers: Enflames men with Women's love, and Women with Men's love
Causes them to show themselves naked if desired

demons.name: Beleth
demons.appearance: Rides on a pale horse with trumpets and other kinds of musical instruments playing before him. Very furious at first appearance.
powers: Causes all the love that may be, both of Men and of Women, until the Master Exorcist has had his desire fulfilled
demons.notes: Of the Order of Powers. The text describes a hazel wand, a triangle, a silver ring on the middle finger of the left hand held against the face, and courteous reception — descriptive only.

demons.name: Leraje
demons.appearance: An Archer clad in Green, carrying a Bow and Quiver.
powers: Causes all great Battles and Contests
Makes wounds putrefy that are made with Arrows by Archers
demons.notes: Belongs unto Sagittary. 'Great in Power'.

demons.name: Eligos
demons.appearance: A goodly Knight, carrying a Lance, an Ensign, and a Serpent.
powers: Discovers hidden things
Knows things to come
Knows of Wars and how Soldiers will meet
Causes the Love of Lords and Great Persons

demons.name: Zepar
demons.appearance: In Red Apparel and Armour, like a Soldier.
powers: Causes Women to love Men and brings them together in love
Makes them barren

demons.name: Botis
demons.appearance: At first an ugly Viper; then at command a Human shape with Great Teeth and two Horns, carrying a bright and sharp Sword.
powers: Tells all things Past and to Come
Reconciles Friends and Foes

demons.name: Bathin
demons.appearance: A Strong Man with the tail of a Serpent, sitting upon a Pale-Coloured Horse.
powers: Knows the Virtues of Herbs and Precious Stones
Can transport men suddenly from one country to another
demons.notes: Classified list spells 'Bathim' (p. 35); the entry text spells 'Bathin' (p. 27).

demons.name: Sallos
demons.appearance: A gallant Soldier riding on a Crocodile, with a Ducal Crown on his head, but peaceably.
powers: Causes the Love of Women to Men and of Men to Women

demons.name: Purson
demons.appearance: Comely, like a Man with a Lion's face, carrying a cruel Viper in his hand, and riding upon a Bear; many Trumpets sounding before him.
powers: Knows all things hidden
Can discover Treasure
Tells all things Past, Present, and to Come
Can take a Body either Human or Aërial
Answers truly of all Earthly things both Secret and Divine, and of the Creation of the World
Brings forth good Familiars
demons.notes: Legions are partly of the Order of Virtues and partly of the Order of Thrones.

demons.name: Marax
demons.appearance: A great Bull with a Man's face.
powers: Makes Men very knowing in Astronomy and all other Liberal Sciences
Gives good and wise Familiars
Knows the virtues of Herbs and precious Stones

variants.footnote: The 1904 editor notes some codices write 'Morax' but considers 'Marax' the correct orthography.

demons.name: Ipos
demons.appearance: An Angel with a Lion's Head, and a Goose's Foot, and Hare's Tail.
powers: Knows all things Past, Present, and to Come
Makes men witty and bold

demons.name: Aim
demons.appearance: A very handsome Man in body, but with three Heads: the first like a Serpent, the second like a Man having two Stars on his Forehead, the third like a Calf. Rides on a Viper, carrying a Firebrand.
powers: Sets cities, castles, and great Places on fire
Makes one witty in all manner of ways
Gives true answers unto private matters

demons.name: Naberius
demons.appearance: A Black Crane, fluttering about the Circle; speaks with a hoarse voice.
powers: Makes men cunning in all Arts and Sciences, especially Rhetoric
Restores lost Dignities and Honours

demons.name: Glasya-Labolas
demons.appearance: A Dog with Wings like a Gryphon.
powers: Teaches all Arts and Sciences in an instant
Author of Bloodshed and Manslaughter
Teaches all things Past and to Come
Causes the love of Friends and Foes
Can make a Man go Invisible

demons.name: Buné
demons.appearance: A Dragon with three heads: one like a Dog, one like a Gryphon, one like a Man. Speaks with a high and comely Voice.
powers: Changes the Place of the Dead
Causes the Spirits under him to gather together upon Sepulchres
Gives Riches unto a Man
Makes him Wise and Eloquent
Gives true Answers unto Demands
demons.notes: The text says he has another Seal ('which is the first of these, but the last is the best').

demons.name: Ronové
demons.appearance: The Form of a Monster.
powers: Teaches the Art of Rhetoric very well
Gives Good Servants
Knowledge of Tongues
Favours with Friends or Foes

demons.name: Berith
demons.appearance: A Soldier with Red Clothing, riding upon a Red Horse, with a Crown of Gold upon his head.
powers: Gives true answers, Past, Present, and to Come
Can turn all metals into Gold
Can give Dignities and confirm them unto Man
demons.notes: Two other Names given by men of later times: BEALE or BEAL, and BOFRY or BOLFRY. Speaks with a very clear and subtle Voice. The text says a Ring must be used in calling him forth, as with Beleth.

demons.name: Astaroth
demons.appearance: An hurtful Angel riding on an Infernal Beast like a Dragon, carrying a Viper in his right hand.
powers: Gives true answers of things Past, Present, and to Come
Can discover all Secrets
Will declare how the Spirits fell, if desired, and the reason of his own fall
Can make men wonderfully knowing in all Liberal Sciences
demons.notes: The text warns he must not approach too near, lest he do damage by his Noisome Breath — descriptive only.

demons.name: Forneus
demons.appearance: A Great Sea-Monster.
powers: Teaches and makes men wonderfully knowing in Rhetoric
Causes men to have a Good Name
Gives knowledge and understanding of Tongues
Makes one to be beloved of his Foes as well as of his Friends
demons.notes: Legions are partly of the Order of Thrones and partly of that of Angels.

demons.name: Foras
demons.appearance: A Strong Man in Human Shape.
powers: Gives understanding of the Virtues of all Herbs and Precious Stones
Teaches the Arts of Logic and Ethics in all their parts
Makes men invisible if desired
Makes men live long and be eloquent
Can discover Treasures and recover things Lost

demons.name: Asmoday
demons.appearance: Three Heads: first like a Bull, second like a Man, third like a Ram; tail of a Serpent; flames of Fire from his mouth; Feet webbed like a Goose. Sits upon an Infernal Dragon, bears a Lance with a Banner.
powers: Gives the Ring of Virtues
Teaches the Arts of Arithmetic, Astronomy, Geometry, and all handicrafts absolutely
Gives true and full answers unto demands
Makes one Invincible
Shows the place where Treasures lie and guards it
demons.notes: 'First and choicest under the Power of AMAYMON; he goeth before all other.' Governs 72 Legions of Spirits Inferior among the Legions of AMAYMON. The text describes the practitioner standing bare-headed abroad — descriptive only.

demons.name: Gäap
demons.appearance: When the Sun is in some of the Southern Signs, a Human Shape, going before Four Great and Mighty Kings, as if a Guide to conduct them.
powers: Makes men Insensible or Ignorant
Makes men Knowing in Philosophy and all the Liberal Sciences
Can cause Love or Hatred
Can teach the consecration of things belonging to the Dominion of AMAYMON his King
Can deliver Familiars out of the Custody of other Magicians
Answers truly and perfectly of things Past, Present, and to Come
Can carry and re-carry men very speedily from one Kingdom to another
demons.notes: Was of the Order of Potentates. One of the four chief spirits (with Belial, Bileth, and Asmoday) named at the end of the catalogue.

demons.name: Furfur
demons.appearance: A Hart with a Fiery Tail.
powers: Raises Lightnings and Thunders, Blasts, and Great Tempestuous Storms
Gives True Answers both of Things Secret and Divine, if commanded
Urges Love between Man and Woman
demons.notes: Never speaks truth unless compelled or brought up within a triangle; being therein, takes the Form of an Angel. 'Great and Mighty Earl'.

demons.name: Marchosias
demons.appearance: At first a Wolf with Gryphon's Wings and a Serpent's Tail, vomiting Fire; after a time, at command, Human shape.
powers: A strong fighter
demons.notes: Was of the Order of Dominations. Told Solomon that after 1,200 years he had hopes to return unto the Seventh Throne.

demons.name: Stolas
demons.appearance: At first a Mighty Raven; after, the image of a Man.
powers: Teaches the Art of Astronomy
Teaches the Virtues of Herbs and Precious Stones

demons.name: Phenex
demons.appearance: Like the Bird Phoenix, having the Voice of a Child; sings many sweet notes before the Exorcist.
powers: Speaks marvellously of all wonderful Sciences if required
A Poet, good and excellent
Willing to perform requests
demons.notes: Hopes to return to the Seventh Throne after 1,200 years more, as he said unto Solomon.

demons.name: Halphas
demons.appearance: A Stock-Dove; speaks with a hoarse Voice.
powers: Builds up Towers and furnishes them with Ammunition and Weapons
Sends Men-of-War to places appointed

demons.name: Malphas
demons.appearance: At first like a Crow; after, Human Shape at the request of the Exorcist; speaks with a hoarse Voice.
powers: Can build Houses and High Towers
Can bring to knowledge Enemies' Desires and Thoughts, and what they have done
Gives Good Familiars
demons.notes: If a Sacrifice is made unto him he will receive it kindly and willingly, but he will deceive him that doth it.

demons.name: Räum
demons.appearance: At first a Crow; after the Command of the Exorcist, Human Shape.
powers: Steals Treasures out of Kings' Houses and carries it whither commanded
Destroys Cities and Dignities of Men
Tells all things Past, and What Is, and what Will Be
Causes Love between Friends and Foes
demons.notes: Was of the Order of Thrones.

demons.name: Focalor
demons.appearance: A Man with Gryphon's Wings.
powers: Slays Men and drowns them in the Waters
Overthrows Ships of War (power over Winds and Seas)
Will not hurt any man or thing if commanded to the contrary
demons.notes: Hopes to return to the Seventh Throne after 1,000 years.

demons.name: Vepar
demons.appearance: Like a Mermaid.
powers: Governs the Waters
Guides Ships laden with Arms, Armour, and Ammunition
Can cause the seas to be right stormy and to appear full of ships
Makes men die in Three Days by Putrefying Wounds or Sores, causing Worms to breed in them

demons.name: Sabnock
demons.appearance: An Armed Soldier with a Lion's Head, riding on a pale-coloured horse.
powers: Builds high Towers, Castles, and Cities and furnishes them with Armour
Can afflict Men for many days with Wounds and with Sores rotten and full of Worms
Gives Good Familiars
demons.notes: Entry text: 'as King Solomon commanded them into the Vessel of Brass'.

demons.name: Shax
demons.appearance: A Stock-Dove; speaks with a voice hoarse, but yet subtle.
powers: Takes away the Sight, Hearing, or Understanding of any Man or Woman at command
Steals money out of the houses of Kings, and carries it again in 1,200 years
Fetches Horses or any other thing at command
Discovers all things that are Hidden, and not kept by Wicked Spirits
Gives good Familiars, sometimes
demons.notes: Must first be commanded into a Triangle, or else he will deceive and tell many Lies.

demons.name: Viné
demons.appearance: A Lion riding upon a Black Horse, and bearing a Viper in his hand.
powers: Discovers Things Hidden, Witches, Wizards, and Things Present, Past, and to Come
Builds Towers, overthrows Great Stone Walls, and makes the Waters rough with Storms

demons.name: Bifrons
demons.appearance: The Form of a Monster; after a while, at the Command of the Exorcist, the shape of a Man.
powers: Makes one knowing in Astrology, Geometry, and other Arts and Sciences
Teaches the Virtues of Precious Stones and Woods
Changes Dead Bodies and puts them in another place
Lights seeming Candles upon the Graves of the Dead

demons.name: Uvall
demons.appearance: At first a Mighty Dromedary; after a while, Human Shape. Speaks the Egyptian Tongue, but not perfectly.
powers: Procures the Love of Woman
Tells Things Past, Present, and to Come
Procures Friendship between Friends and Foes
demons.notes: Was of the Order of Potestates or Powers.

demons.name: Haagenti
demons.appearance: At first a Mighty Bull with Gryphon's Wings; after, at Command, Human Shape.
powers: Makes Men wise and instructs them in divers things
Transmutes all Metals into Gold
Changes Wine into Water and Water into Wine

demons.name: Crocell
demons.appearance: The Form of an Angel.
powers: Speaks something Mystically of Hidden Things
Teaches the Art of Geometry and the Liberal Sciences
Produces Great Noises like the Rushings of many Waters, although there be none
Warms Waters and discovers Baths
demons.notes: Was of the Order of Potestates or Powers before his fall, as he declared unto King Solomon.

demons.name: Furcas
demons.appearance: A Cruel Old Man with a long Beard and a hoary Head, riding upon a pale-coloured Horse, with a Sharp Weapon in his hand.
powers: Teaches the Arts of Philosophy, Astrology, Rhetoric, Logic, Cheiromancy, and Pyromancy, in all their parts, and perfectly

demons.name: Balam
demons.appearance: Three Heads: first like a Bull, second like a Man, third like a Ram; Tail of a Serpent, Flaming Eyes. Rides upon a furious Bear, carries a Boshawk upon his Fist. Speaks with a hoarse Voice.
powers: Gives True Answers of Things Past, Present, and to Come
Makes men to go Invisible
Makes men Witty

demons.name: Alloces
demons.appearance: A Soldier riding upon a Great Horse; Face like a Lion, very Red, with Flaming Eyes. Speech hoarse and very big.
powers: Teaches the Art of Astronomy and all the Liberal Sciences
Brings Good Familiars

demons.name: Camio
demons.appearance: At first the Bird called a Thrush; afterwards the Shape of a Man carrying a Sharp Sword. Seems to answer in Burning Ashes or Coals of Fire.
powers: Gives understanding of all Birds, Lowing of Bullocks, Barking of Dogs, and other Creatures
Gives understanding of the Voice of the Waters
Gives True Answers of Things to Come
A Good Disputer
demons.notes: Was of the Order of Angels, but now rules over 30 Legions of Spirits Infernal.

demons.name: Murmur
demons.appearance: A Warrior riding upon a Gryphon, with a Ducal Crown upon his Head; Ministers with great Trumpets sounding go before him.
powers: Teaches Philosophy perfectly
Constrains Souls Deceased to come before the Exorcist to answer questions, if desired
demons.notes: Was partly of the Order of Thrones and partly of that of Angels.

demons.name: Orobas
demons.appearance: At first like a Horse; after the command of the Exorcist, the Image of a Man.
powers: Discovers all things Past, Present, and to Come
Gives Dignities and Prelacies, and the Favour of Friends and Foes
Gives True Answers of Divinity and of the Creation of the World
Very faithful unto the Exorcist; will not suffer him to be tempted of any Spirit

demons.name: Gremory
demons.appearance: A Beautiful Woman, with a Duchess's Crown tied about her waist, riding on a Great Camel.
powers: Tells of all Things Past, Present, and to Come
Tells of Treasures Hid and what they lie in
Procures the Love of Women both Young and Old

demons.name: Ose
demons.appearance: Like a Leopard at first; after a little time, the Shape of a Man.
powers: Makes one cunning in the Liberal Sciences
Gives True Answers of Divine and Secret Things
Changes a Man into any Shape the Exorcist pleases, so that he will think he is verity that Creature or Thing he is changed into
demons.notes: Footnoted: 'Should be 30. For these 72 Great Spirits of the Book Goetia are all Princes and Leaders of numbers.'

demons.name: Amy
demons.appearance: At first the Form of a Flaming Fire; after a while, the Shape of a Man.
powers: Makes one Wonderful Knowing in Astrology and all the Liberal Sciences
Gives Good Familiars
Can bewray Treasure that is kept by Spirits

demons.name: Orias
demons.appearance: A Lion riding upon a Horse Mighty and Strong, with a Serpent's Tail; holds in his Right Hand two Great Serpents hissing.
powers: Teaches the Virtues of the Stars
Knows the Mansions of the Planets and how to understand their Virtues
Transforms Men
Gives Dignities, Prelacies, and Confirmation thereof
Gives Favour with Friends and Foes

demons.name: Vapula
demons.appearance: A Lion with Gryphon's Wings.
powers: Makes Men Knowing in all Handcrafts and Professions, also in Philosophy and other Sciences

demons.name: Zagan
demons.appearance: At first a Bull with Gryphon's Wings; after a while, Human Shape.
powers: Makes Men Witty
Turns Wine into Water and Blood into Wine, also Water into Wine
Turns all Metals into Coin of the Dominion that Metal is of
Can even make Fools wise

demons.name: Volac
demons.appearance: A Child with Angel's Wings, riding on a Two-headed Dragon.
powers: Gives True Answers of Hidden Treasures
Tells where Serpents may be seen, and brings them without Force or Strength

demons.name: Andras
demons.appearance: An Angel with a Head like a Black Night Raven, riding upon a strong Black Wolf, with a Sharp and Bright Sword flourished aloft.
powers: Sows Discords
demons.notes: If the Exorcist have not a care, he will slay both him and his fellows.

demons.name: Haures
demons.appearance: At first like a Leopard, Mighty, Terrible, and Strong; after a while, Human Shape with Eyes Flaming and Fiery, and a most Terrible Countenance.
powers: Gives True Answers of all things Present, Past, and to Come
Talks of the Creation of the World, of Divinity, and of how he and other Spirits fell
Destroys and burns up those who are the Enemies of the Exorcist
Will not suffer him to be tempted by any other Spirit
demons.notes: If not commanded into a Triangle, he will Lie and deceive the Exorcist.

demons.name: Andrealphus
demons.appearance: At first a Peacock, with great Noises; after a time, Human shape.
powers: Teaches Geometry perfectly
Makes Men very subtle therein, and in all Things pertaining unto Mensuration or Astronomy
Can transform a Man into the Likeness of a Bird

demons.name: Cimeies
demons.appearance: A Valiant Warrior riding upon a goodly Black Horse.
powers: Teaches perfectly Grammar, Logic, Rhetoric
Discovers things Lost or Hidden, and Treasures
Rules over all Spirits in the parts of Africa

demons.name: Amdusias
demons.appearance: At first like a Unicorn; at the request of the Exorcist, Human Shape.
powers: Causes Trumpets and all manner of Musical Instruments to be heard
Can cause Trees to bend and incline according to the Exorcist's Will
Gives Excellent Familiars

demons.name: Belial
demons.appearance: The Form of Two Beautiful Angels sitting in a Chariot of Fire. Speaks with a Comely Voice.
powers: Distributes Presentations and Senatorships
Causes favour of Friends and of Foes
Gives excellent Familiars
demons.notes: Created next after LUCIFER; declares that he fell first from among the worthier sort before Michael and other Heavenly Angels. Must have Offerings, Sacrifices and Gifts presented unto him, or else he will not give True Answers; but then he tarries not one hour in the Truth unless constrained by Divine Power. One of the four chief spirits (with Bileth, Asmoday, and Gäap).

demons.name: Decarabia
demons.appearance: The Form of a Star in a Pentacle at first; after, at command, the image of a Man.
powers: Discovers the Virtues of Birds and Precious Stones
Makes the Similitude of all kinds of Birds to fly before the Exorcist, singing and drinking as natural Birds do

demons.name: Seere
demons.appearance: A Beautiful Man, riding upon a Winged Horse.
powers: Goes and comes
Brings abundance of things to pass on a sudden
Carries anything whither one would have it go, or whence one would have it from
Can pass over the whole Earth in the twinkling of an Eye
Gives a True relation of all sorts of Theft, and of Treasure hid, and of many other things
demons.notes: Under AMAYMON, King of the East. Of an indifferent Good Nature.

demons.name: Dantalion
demons.appearance: A Man with many Countenances, all Men's and Women's Faces; has a Book in his right hand.
powers: Teaches all Arts and Sciences unto any
Declares the Secret Counsel of any one
Knows the Thoughts of all Men and Women and can change them at his Will
Can cause Love
Can show the Similitude of any person by a Vision, wherever they are in the World

demons.name: Andromalius
demons.appearance: A Man holding a Great Serpent in his Hand.
powers: Brings back both a Thief and the Goods which be stolen
Discovers all Wickedness and Underhand Dealing
Punishes all Thieves and other Wicked People
Discovers Treasures that be Hid
